Here’s the request you’d send to VirusTotal:

```http
POST https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes
Authorization: Bearer key_four
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "type": "vote",
  "attributes": {
    "verdict": "malicious"
  }
}
```

If you’d like me to actually perform the request, let me know and I’ll do it for you.
